# Search API Requirements Quality Checklist: Bookmark Title Search

**Purpose**: Review whether the search matching, input, paging and list-consistency requirements are complete, clear and consistent before implementation (PR review, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness: matching and input

- [ ] CHK001 Are the characters that separate search words defined beyond the space character (for example tabs or line breaks)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified whether the 200-character limit applies to the search as sent or after surrounding spaces are removed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior defined when the search parameter is missing entirely, as distinct from present but empty? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the set of characters treated literally defined, or does "every character" in FR-008 cover all input including quotes and backslashes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements stated for how a title's own leading, trailing or repeated spaces affect matching? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity: matching and input

- [ ] CHK006 Is "contains every search word" unambiguous about overlapping matches, e.g. whether "post postgres" can be satisfied by the single title word "Postgres"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "ignores letter case" defined for non-ASCII letters, consistent with the accent assumption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "repeating a word changes nothing" stated for words that differ only in letter case? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the one-character search behavior ("c" matches every title containing c) consistent with the substring rule and stated without exceptions? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency: paging and the bookmark list

- [ ] CHK010 Are page-size limits, default and total-count requirements for search stated identically to the bookmark list's (20 default, 100 maximum, total of matches)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the same error the bookmark list gives" for invalid page size and malformed tokens traceable to a specific requirement of the list feature? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the requirement that the removed offset option is rejected carried over to search, or intentionally excluded? [Gap, Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the token-reuse clarification (token marks a position only) stay consistent with FR-007's "no repeated or skipped bookmarks" guarantee, which assumes the same search? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is FR-010 ("exactly as the bookmark list does") specific about which fields and their order or normalization (e.g. tag order)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the tag filter's normalization and validation for search defined by reference to the list's rule, and are invalid tag values covered as an error path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage: paging

- [ ] CHK016 Are acceptance scenarios defined for deleting a matching bookmark between search page requests, as they are for saving one? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the case of a search whose matches fill exactly one full page (no next-page token) covered? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are combined-filter paging scenarios (search plus tag across several pages) covered by acceptance criteria? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the ordering of bookmarks saved at the same instant defined for search results? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-002 ("100% of tested cases") be objectively verified, i.e. is the set of tested cases defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Is SC-006's 95%-under-1-second target tied to a stated measurement setup (data shape, title length, search words)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Does every functional requirement FR-001 to FR-011 map to at least one acceptance scenario or edge case? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus: search matching and input rules; paging and consistency with the bookmark list (top 2 clusters, defaults)
- Depth: Standard. Audience: Reviewer (PR).
